label: Product reports
description: Product sales performance for a single reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time). Orders from this moment on fall in the next period.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Products sold
fields.description: Different products with at least one paid sale in this period.

fields.label: Previous period products sold
fields.description: The same count for the period just before this one: the previous day, week or 14 days, or the previous calendar month.

fields.label: Units sold
fields.description: Total units sold across all products.

fields.label: Item revenue
fields.description: Revenue from items sold, before shipping, tax and refunds.

fields.label: Top products' share %
fields.description: Share of item revenue that came from the best sellers listed.

fields.label: Product report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

params.note: This store has more orders or products than the report reads, so some figures and lists cover only part of the period.

rows.label: Products sold
rows.hint: Different products with at least one paid sale in this period.

rows.label: Previous period products sold
rows.hint: The same count for the period just before this one: the previous day, week or 14 days, or the previous calendar month.

rows.label: Products with no sales
rows.hint: Active products, created before this period, that sold nothing in it. Shows — when List products with no sales is off.

rows.label: Units sold
rows.hint: Total units sold across all products.

rows.label: Item revenue
rows.hint: Revenue from items sold, before shipping, tax and refunds.

rows.label: Best sellers' share
rows.hint: Share of item revenue that came from the best sellers listed (up to 10).
rows.caption: {top_products_count} of {products_sold_count} products

fields.label: Best sellers
fields.description: Best sellers in this period, ranked by item revenue.

params.empty: No products sold in this period.

fields.label: Slowest sellers
fields.description: Products that sold in this period, starting from the least revenue.

params.empty: Every product that sold is already listed under Best sellers.

fields.label: Biggest movers
fields.description: Products whose revenue changed the most compared with the previous period, up or down.

params.empty: No product's revenue changed compared with the previous period.

fields.label: Products with no sales
fields.description: Active products, created before this period, that sold nothing in it.

fields.label: No sales
fields.description: Active products, created before this period, that sold nothing in it.

params.empty: Every active product sold at least once, or this list is turned off in the app settings.
params.unlisted_note: {n} more products had no sales. Each report lists up to 10.

fields.label: Partial
fields.description: Yes when the store had more orders than one report reads, so rankings cover only part of the period.

fields.label: Products sold
fields.template: {% if products_sold_count == nil %}—{% else %}{% assign rp_n = products_sold_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %}{% endif %}

fields.label: Units
fields.template: {% if units_sold == nil %}—{% else %}{% assign rp_n = units_sold | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %}{% endif %}

fields.label: No sales
fields.template: {% if unsold_count == nil %}—{% else %}{% assign rp_n = unsold_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
